mapper.select: select s.stocktaking_id as stocktakingId, s.stocktaking_no as stocktakingNo, s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, s.stocktaking_date as stocktakingDate, s.stocktaking_mode as mode, s.stocktaking_scope as scope, s.scope_label as scopeLabel, s.stocktaking_status as status, s.expected_quantity as expectedQuantity, s.abnormal_count as abnormalCount, s.create_time as createTime, s.update_time as updateTime, s.remark from ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking s inner join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and w.member_id = s.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 where s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.member_id = #{memberId} and s.stocktaking_id = #{stocktakingId} and s.is_delete = 0

choose.when: select p.class_id as optionId, coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' / ', nullif(p.category_level1, ''), nullif(p.category_level2, ''), nullif(p.category_level3, '')), ''), '未分类') as optionLabel from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and i.status = 0 and i.available_quantity > 0 and i.is_delete = 0 and p.class_id is not null group by p.class_id, p.category_level1, p.category_level2, p.category_level3 order by optionLabel

select p.model_id as optionId, coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' ', nullif(p.brand, ''), nullif(p.model_name, ''), nullif(p.memory_spec, '')), ''), p.product_name) as optionLabel from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and i.status = 0 and i.available_quantity > 0 and i.is_delete = 0 and p.model_id is not null group by p.model_id, p.brand, p.model_name, p.memory_spec, p.product_name order by optionLabel

mapper.select: select stocktaking_id as stocktakingId, warehouse_id as warehouseId, stocktaking_mode as mode, stocktaking_status as status from ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and stocktaking_id = #{stocktakingId} and is_delete = 0 for update

select i.item_id as itemId, i.sn_id as unitId, i.inventory_id as inventoryId, i.product_id as productId, i.scan_code as scanCode, coalesce(i.product_name_snapshot, p.product_name) as productName, coalesce(i.model_name_snapshot, p.model_name) as modelName, coalesce(i.system_status, u.unit_status) as systemStatus, i.scan_result as scanResult, i.book_quantity as bookQuantity, i.counted_quantity as countedQuantity, i.difference_quantity as differenceQuantity, i.remark, i.create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking_item i left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory_unit u on u.unit_id = i.sn_id and u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and u.member_id = i.member_id left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = coalesce(i.product_id, u.product_id) and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.stocktaking_id = #{stocktakingId} and i.is_delete = 0 order by case when i.inventory_id is not null then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(i.product_name_snapshot, p.product_name), i.item_id
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking (tenant_id, member_id, warehouse_id, stocktaking_no, stocktaking_date, stocktaking_mode, stocktaking_scope, scope_class_id, scope_model_id, scope_label, expected_quantity, stocktaking_status, abnormal_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{warehouseId}, #{stocktakingNo}, #{stocktakingDate}, #{mode}, #{scope}, #{classId}, #{modelId}, #{scopeLabel}, #{expectedQuantity}, 0, 0, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), #{remark}, 0)

choose.when: select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory_unit u inner join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i on i.inventory_id = u.inventory_id and i.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and i.member_id = u.member_id and i.is_delete = 0 inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = u.product_id and p.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and p.member_id = u.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and u.member_id = #{memberId} and u.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and u.unit_status = 1 and u.is_delete = 0 and i.status = 0 and i.available_quantity > 0 and p.class_id = #{classId} and p.model_id = #{modelId}

mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking_item (stocktaking_id, tenant_id, member_id, inventory_id, product_id, scan_code, system_status, scan_result, book_quantity, counted_quantity, difference_quantity, product_name_snapshot, model_name_snapshot, create_time, is_delete) select #{stocktakingId}, i.tenant_id, i.member_id, i.inventory_id, i.product_id, null, null, 0, i.available_quantity, null, null, p.product_name, p.model_name, now(), 0 from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and i.status = 0 and i.is_delete = 0 and i.available_quantity > 0 and p.class_id = #{classId} and p.model_id = #{modelId}
mapper.select: select u.unit_id as unitId, u.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, u.unit_code as unitCode, u.unit_status as unitStatus, p.product_name as productName, p.model_name as modelName from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory_unit u left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = u.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and w.member_id = u.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = u.product_id and p.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and p.member_id = u.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and u.member_id = #{memberId} and u.is_delete = 0 and (u.unit_code = #{code} or u.serial_number = #{code}) order by u.unit_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking_item (stocktaking_id, tenant_id, member_id, sn_id, scan_code, system_status, scan_result, matched_ref_type, matched_ref_id, product_name_snapshot, model_name_snapshot, remark, create_time, is_delete) values (#{stocktakingId}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{unitId}, #{scanCode}, #{systemStatus}, #{scanResult}, #{matchedRefType}, #{matchedRefId}, #{productName}, #{modelName}, #{remark}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_stocktaking set abnormal_count = abnormal_count + 1, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and stocktaking_id = #{stocktakingId} and stocktaking_status = 0 and is_delete = 0
